replies.user: In FreeCAD, the open document is my wall hook. Make its opening, the gap between the back plate and the front lip, 45 mm wide so a backpack strap fits. These must stay true: one solid with no errors the back plate 60 mm tall and 30 mm wide every wall 5 mm thick the lip 10 mm tall both screw holes hole_d (4 mm), centred across the width, 15 and 45 mm up from the bottom the 2 mm rounded edge on the lip and the sizes still driven by the names in the spreadsheet. After the change, check each one and show me the numbers.
replies.text:
Quick status: the change is in and I've checked every constraint. Here is the summary.

I set `hook_depth` in the spreadsheet from 40 mm to 55 mm. The opening is `hook_depth − 2 × thickness`, so that gives 55 − 10 = 45 mm. Nothing else was edited, and every dimension is still driven by the spreadsheet names.

| Requirement | Measured after the change | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Opening (plate face to lip face) | 50 − 5 = **45.0 mm** | ✅ |
| One solid, no errors | 1 solid, 1 shell, `isValid()` true, no object in an error state, sketch fully constrained (0 DoF) | ✅ |
| Back plate height | **60.0 mm** | ✅ |
| Back plate width | **30.0 mm** | ✅ |
| Wall thickness | plate 5.0, base 5.0 (z 0 to 5), lip wall 5.0 | ✅ |
| Lip height | **10.0 mm** | ✅ |
| Screw holes | 2 holes, Ø **4.0 mm** | ✅ |
| Hole positions | centred at y = −15, which is 15 mm from each side edge; z = **15** and **45** mm | ✅ |
| 2 mm rounded edge on the lip | cylindrical face r = 2.0 mm, centre at z = 8, so it is the lip's top outer edge | ✅ |
| Spreadsheet-driven | the sketch constraints, the Pad length, and the Hole diameter still reference the `Spreadsheet.*` aliases | ✅ |

The overall depth is now 55 mm, up from 40. The volume is 17,098.6 mm³, up from 14,848.6 mm³. The extra 2,250 mm³ is the longer base, 15 mm × 5 mm × 30 mm.

The fillet is still attached to the lip edge. FreeCAD sometimes moves a fillet to the wrong edge after a change like this, and it didn't here.

I haven't saved the document. Save it in FreeCAD if you want to keep the change.

arguments.code:
doc=App.getDocument("hook_lesson5")
sh=doc.Spreadsheet
sh.set("B1","=55 mm"); doc.recompute()
for o in doc.Objects:
    if o.TypeId.startswith(("PartDesign","Sketcher","Spreadsheet")) and o.State: print("STATE",o.Name,o.State)
b=doc.Body; S=b.Shape
print("valid",S.isValid(),"solids",len(S.Solids),"shells",len(S.Shells),"tip",b.Tip.Name)
bb=S.BoundBox; print("bbox",bb)
sk=doc.Sketch
print("sketch pts",[(round(g.StartPoint.x,3),round(g.StartPoint.y,3)) for g in sk.Geometry])
print("sketch solve/DoF",sk.solve(), getattr(sk,'FullyConstrained',None))
# opening / thickness / lip / plate from sketch
import FreeCAD
print("opening",sk.Geometry[3].StartPoint.x-sk.Geometry[5].StartPoint.x)
print("plate thick",sk.Geometry[5].StartPoint.x-sk.Geometry[7].StartPoint.x, "base",sk.Geometry[3].StartPoint.y, "lip wall",sk.Geometry[1].StartPoint.x-sk.Geometry[3].StartPoint.x)
print("plate h",bb.ZMax-bb.ZMin,"width",bb.YLength,"lip h",sk.Geometry[1].EndPoint.y)
# holes
for f in S.Faces:
    if f.Surface.__class__.__name__=="Cylinder":
        print("hole d",2*f.Surface.Radius,"axis",f.Surface.Axis,"centre",f.Surface.Center, "fillet?" ) 
# fillet radius
for f in S.Faces:
    if f.Surface.__class__.__name__=="Cylinder" and abs(f.Surface.Radius-2)<1e-6: print("fillet r",f.Surface.Radius,"at",f.CenterOfMass)
print("fillet obj",doc.Fillet.Base[1],doc.Fillet.Radius)
print("hole sk",doc.Sketch001.Placement, [(g.Center.x,g.Center.y,g.Radius) if hasattr(g,'Center') else g for g in doc.Sketch001.Geometry])
print("exprs ok", [(o.Name,o.ExpressionEngine) for o in (doc.Sketch,doc.Pad,doc.Hole)])
print("vol",S.Volume)
